nexscope/billing.instruction: Check current pricing before execution. Do not automatically retry a paid call.

nexscope/inputExamples.prompt: Keep the product consistent and generate a clean white-background ecommerce hero image.

description: Create and edit ecommerce visuals with precise instruction following, broad visual-style support, world-knowledge grounding, and reliable text rendering through the GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst route. The model is fixed by this API, so provider must not be supplied in the request.

imageUrls.description: Optional public reference image URLs. Omit this field for text-to-image generation, or provide references for image-to-image generation. When supplied, provide 1 to 10 JPG, PNG, or WEBP images; each image must not exceed 20 MB.

outputNum.description: Number of images to generate. Valid range: 1 to 10; defaults to 1.

prompt.description: Generation prompt describing the target image, scene, composition, style, and constraints. Maximum 5000 characters.
prompt.example: Keep the product consistent and generate a clean white-background ecommerce hero image.

quality.description: GPT Image quality. Supported values: low, medium, high, xhigh, max. Defaults to medium.

resolution.description: Output resolution. Supported values: 1K, 2K, or 4K; defaults to 2K.

size.description: Custom GPT text-to-image size, e.g. 1536x1536. Multiples of 16, at most 3840 per side, 655360..8294400 pixels, ratio at most 3:1. No reference images. Omit resolution and aspectRatio; quality defaults to medium.

name: nexscope_gpt_image_2_5_generation
title: GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst
